No failures, only pre-existing unrelated warnings. The fix and tests are complete.

## Summary

The bug was an off-by-one in `PostController.index()` (`app/Http/Controllers/PostController.ts:15`): `Post.paginate()` already treats `page` as 1-based, but the controller called `.paginate({ page: page + 1, ... })`, so the query-schema default (`page: 1`) resolved to page 2 internally — the newest 10 posts were skipped, `?page=1` duplicated page 2's results, and the last page of 25 posts (3 pages) was always empty. Changed it to `.paginate({ page, perPage: 10 })`.

I also added a `posts.index` test suite in `tests/PostController.test.ts` that seeds 25 posts and asserts: the default/`?page=1` request returns the 10 newest posts with `meta.currentPage === 1`, `from === 1`, `to === 10`; and `?page=3` returns the remaining 5 posts instead of being empty. `bun run typecheck`, `bun test` (5 pass, 0 fail), and `bunx guren check` all pass.
